annotations.text: Leading direction — three regions, each subtly tilted in 3D. Fully tappable, cheap to build for real.
Bolder alternate — an arced fan of imagery above the regions, closer to the reference. More custom build effort; the fan stays a hero-only motif, never the ref grid.
One level in — same atmosphere, region glow carried forward.
The ref grid — still the paginated, phone-safe version underneath.
